question: At the December 2021 **BWF** World Tour Finals in Bali, Indonesia, shuttler ____________ clinched the silver medal.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Sindhu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Badminton World Federation **is the **international governing body **for the **sport of badminton **recognized by the **International Olympic Committee**.
 
• It was **founded **in **1934 **as the **International Badminton Federation **with **nine member nations**.
 
• **The BWF **World Championships, formerly known as **IBF World Championships**, and also known as the **World Badminton Championships**, is **a badminton tournament **.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pusarla Venkata Sindhu **is an **Indian badminton player**. Considered one of **India's most successful **sportspersons, Sindhu has **won medals **at various **tournaments **such as the **Olympics **and **on the BWF circuit**, including a **gold at the 2019 **World Championships.
 
• **Aakarshi Kashyap **is an **Indian badminton player**. She has been **selected **to be part of the **Indian team **at the **2018 Asian Games**. She was **part of **the **national women's team **that won the **gold medal in 2019 South Asian Games**. 
 
• **Mugdha Agrey **is a **professional Indian Badminton Player **who is born in **India**. She **plays **her last match during the **Round of 32 **in the **Syed Modi International Women tournament **in the **year 2019**. Her **BWF world ranking **in the **women's singles team of 90 **and she represents as **Indian team **in **the BWF World Series tournaments**.
 
• **Saina Nehwal **is an **Indian professional badminton player**. A former **world no. 1**, she has **won 24 international titles**, which includes **ten Superseries titles**. Although she reached the **world's 2nd in 2009**, it was only in **2015 **that she was able to **attain the world no**.
